entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-11-06
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Clearing NuGet package local cache breaks re-compiling file-based apps #51597
  • Some organizations block `docker load` and `dotnet publish` with SDK container fails #51596
  • Add TargetFrameworks for the dotnetup library and include net472 #51594
  • CA2249 False positive #51588
  • dotnet up should use a separate header for library calls #51586
  • Enhance dotnet up build to use a proper linux container #51585
  • Separate `dotnetup` interactive / noninteractive modes #51584
  • `dotnetUp` should be able to modify user profile to configure path on Unix #51582

Closed

  • Consider setting `EnableDefaultEmbeddedResourceItems` to `false` by default for file-based apps #51506
    10.0.2xx
  • Why are there separate arguments for --project and --solution? #51273
  • Add `dotnetUp` use command #51583

PullRequests

Created

  • Avoid loading middleware when Hot Reload is disabled #51599
  • Explore if allowPrerelease fixes vs22 preview rejections #51598
  • Include EmbeddedResources in Microsoft.DotNet.HotReload.Web.Middleware package #51595
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Set EnableDefaultEmbeddedResourceItems and EnableDefaultNoneItems to false for file-based apps using default SDK #51593
    Servicing-approved
  • Downgrade implicit versions #51592

Merged

  • Set EnableDefaultEmbeddedResourceItems and EnableDefaultNoneItems to false for file-based apps using default SDK #51542
    Area-run-file
  • Include FileBasedPrograms package project in the solution #51587
  • [release/10.0.2xx] Remove razor_tooling from format example ci test #51573

Updated

  • Add warning when using --framework with solution files #51561
  • Add "empty" to console template description #51473
  • Add telemetry logger support for API-based MSBuild usage with BannedApiAnalyzer protection #51068
  • Enable NuGet Audit for security vulnerability scanning #51470
  • Fix `vs2022` Image rejecting preview sdks, failing to resolve sdks #51558
  • Add alpha branding #50468
    Area-CodeFlow
  • Update `.editorconfig` template to set `dotnet_separate_import_directive_groups` to `false` #50476
    Area-Infrastructure, Area-Common templates
  • Ensure that `--nologo` adheres to DOTNET_NOLOGO if present #51462
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #51402
    Area-Templates, Area-Format
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #51376
    Area-Format
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0.2xx' => 'main' #51572
  • Improve clarity of 'dotnet project convert' output directory prompt #51443
    Area-run-file
  • Fix updating `globaljsonworkloadsets.json` #50372
    Area-Workloads
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0.1xx' => 'release/10.0.2xx' #51442
  • real structures around package input formats for dotnet new commands #48892
    stale
  • [automated] Update man pages #51504
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/8.0.1xx' => 'release/8.0.3xx' #51388
